name: @teactjs/runtime
description: Bot runtime engine for Teact — router, sessions, middleware, hooks

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/renderer --external @teactjs/react --external @teactjs/runtime --external @teactjs/telegram --external @teactjs/storage --external i18next --external react-i18next && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
